About Me

I'm Gian Carl Librada, an aspiring QA Tester and Front-End Web Developer based in San Pedro, Laguna. I have hands-on experience finding, reproducing, and documenting real software bugs through platforms like Test IO, where my reports have been accepted and forwarded by customers.

I combine a tester's eye for detail with a developer's understanding of code, letting me catch issues others might miss and communicate them clearly. I have an understanding of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, PHP, Python, C++, and Laravel, along with a background in UI/UX design and multimedia design. I thrive in environments that demand precision, curiosity, and a commitment to quality.

Services

Manual Bug Finding

Thoroughly testing web and mobile applications by hand to uncover functional, visual, and content defects before they reach real users.

Bug Reporting & Documentation

Writing clear, detailed bug reports with steps to reproduce, expected vs actual results, severity, and supporting evidence like screenshots.

Exploratory Testing

Going beyond scripted test cases to freely investigate the application, uncovering edge cases and unexpected behaviors through intuition and experience.

Regression Testing

Re-testing previously fixed bugs and core features after updates to ensure new changes haven't broken existing functionality.

    Web-Based Event Management and Monitoring System for Diabetes Philippines

    Capstone Project: A web-based Event Management and Monitoring System featuring event registration, QR code attendance tracking, online payment integration, email notifications, certificate generation, delegate feedback submission, and reports for attendance, registrations, and feedback results.

    B5 Personality Test Admin System

    B5 Personality Test Admin System is an admin panel developed during my internship using Laravel for managing the B5 personality test. It enables administrators to create, update, and organize test questions and other assessment content through a user-friendly interface.

    Paige Invitation
